meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed canonical StoreStats report reuse, strict report/date/limit validation, actor policy, sanitized private evidence replay and capability help. Updated runtime instructions, observability and generated contracts. Private source navigation works in both successful A2UI and fallback answers; focused80 and golden33 checks pass.

auth.review_note: Reviewed owner-only capability policy and unchanged authentication routes against the shared backend guidance. Browser claims cannot grant commerce_report; guest/customer denial and foreign-owner saved evidence denial are covered. Existing auth references remain accurate.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed product, stock, customer and coupon projections against existing StoreStats calculations. Documented line-count versus order-count, allocated refunds, within-period anonymous customer bands, missing customer keys and current status without quantities. Canonical commerce services and normal payment/order flows are unchanged.

content.review_note: Reviewed public ProductService and BlogService published selection and exclusion of future, draft, retired or private Markdown and paths.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the bounded Enterprise extension, source dependency metadata and shared guidance. Business records remain in MySQL and sanitized report evidence stays within actor-owned conversation JSON. No new public privileges, booking flow, runtime agent, application dependency or storage format was introduced.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the shared frontend guidance correction: it now describes existing retired public consultation routes. Google reporting, consent, tag delivery and integration source behavior are unchanged; its integration references remain accurate.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed shared backend guidance changes and existing request-failure references. Commerce report additions do not alter bootstrap or HTTP error handling; the newly fixed public discovery entry routes remain preserved.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the task disclosure, pointer/keyboard editable prompts, no-JavaScript text, canonical report links and owner/public renderer boundaries. Updated admin/help guidance and corrected the stale frontend booking sentence to the existing retired route behavior. Native browser checks are required in CI.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController changes limited to Enterprise capabilities and follow-up report context. No mail scheduling, transport, inbox or template behavior changes; existing email setup and backend references remain accurate.

mcp-clients.review_note: Cross-checked STDIO product selectors against PublicKnowledgeService schemas and shop/integrations guidance; owner grants and local credential transport remain unchanged.

media.review_note: Compared the architecture change with media ownership/deletion guidance. The widget consumes the same validated public raster paths and introduces no upload, deletion, metadata mutation or additional media authority.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the Enterprise task guide against actor-filtered capabilities, report contracts and the actual fill-only composer. Added registry, policy and trace sources to the guide dependency manifest so later changes require review. Owner source links and retired-booking limits match the implemented routes.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed public MCP and A2UI references against the new owner-only report link allowlists. Public tools and data remain unchanged; Support/public scopes reject private report navigation. Focused scope tests cover these boundaries.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed CI wiring for the new80-check commerce regression on native PHP versions and capability/link Chrome fixtures. Generated contracts/maps reflect the fixed two-agent architecture; GitHub remains the issue tracker and source documentation review rules remain unchanged.
